answer: Rotate the session key per task and bind it to the work receipt, not the account. Route rewards into a vesting stream that releases only against future work. What breaks first is key custody: rotation is cheap, so it proves nothing alone and the vesting is the load-bearing part. A thousand identities then need a thousand continuous work streams before one token unlocks, and the bridge from one epoch to the next is paid in copper, since spent timber of past output carries no credit.
